_published_faq.name: How do I add Highspot to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Highspot to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.highspot.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Highspot MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Highspot provides these MCP tools: search_content, get_content_answer, get_deal_answer, lookup_deal, get_content_recommendations, get_item_content, and generate_pitch.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Highspot?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Highspot in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
Highspot requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Highspot is developed by Highspot. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
